THIS IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. (this is NOT a solicitation) This is a notice of intent to award a competitive BPA Call Order against the Forest Service – Region 9 Facilities Blanket Purchase Agreements for Zone 4 in the Forest Products Laboratory.(Only contractors with an active BPA for the respective zone will be eligible for this call order.)

Work includes but is not limited to: Parking Lot Sealcoating, and associated road repairs.
